task.question: Who inaugurated the Noida International Airport in India in March 2026?
task.evidence: 28 March – The Noida International Airport is inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

answer:
The Noida International Airport was inaugurated on 28 March 2026 by the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India. 

FINAL: Hon'ble Prime Minister of India

Who inaugurated the Noida International Airport in India in March 2026?

[Noida International Airport] Noida International Airport (IATA: DXN, ICAO: VIND), also called Jewar Airport, is an international airport at Jewar in the Gautam Buddha Nagar district of Uttar Pradesh, India, serving the National Capital Region and western Uttar Pradesh. In its first phase, the airport has one runway and one passenger terminal with a capacity of 12 million passengers annually. The airport will increase this capacity to 30 million passengers annually in the upcoming years. The airport is intended to complement Indira Gandhi International Airport as part of the Delhi-NCR region's dual-airport system. The first phase was inaugurated on 28 March 2026, following the grant of an aerodrome licence by the DGCA on 6 March 2026. Commercial operations began on 15 June 2026.
